narr: The heavy rain events of recent days in adjacent eastern Kentucky crossed into southwest Virginia on the 28th and produced significant flash flooding, especially around Pound VA.
ev: Rock Switch Rd near Guest River Rd was impassable due to flood waters of the Guest River.
Route 23 was closed between Pound and Wise because of flooding. Shelter was being opened for those who had been evacuated.
Swift water rescues occurred, including along Business Route 23 at Kanawha Rd.
Water rescue needed along the Guest River near Coeburn.

Creek flooding along South Mountain Road washed away the asphalt from the road next to Lone Pine Chapel Church, and washed out some of the ground beneath some foundation pillars of a veterinary hospital next door.

Flooding closed roadways near the intersection of Big Branch Rd and South Fork Rd, and a home was flooded. Minor flooding of businesses and the river gage house on Main Street. Flooding was also beginning in the Pound Bottom community, which was being monitored for potential evacuations.
US-23 Business Route south of Pound was flooded in several places. Riverside Drive in the Pound Bottom community was flooded near the hairpin turn.
lsr: BIG BRANCH ROAD AND SOUTH FORK ROAD INTERSECTION CLOSED BECAUSE OF FLOODING. FLOODING ALSO IN THE POUND BOTTOM COMMUNITY THAT MAY REQUIRE EVACUATIONS.
